findings.evidence: “Read the content the user provides” restates routine input handling. The eight-line Source and extraction section is largely activation, while the six-line Gotchas section largely repeats earlier constraints; the strongest delta is concentrated in the first-rep and evidence-routing rules.
findings.fix: Compress routine intake and repeated intent/provenance guidance while retaining safeguards. Spend the saved space on a compact worked example distinguishing artifact evidence, noisy outcomes, and the resulting next-rep decision.

findings.evidence: “Each proposed later rep should add or change exactly one element relative to the prior rep” applies controlled-experiment rigidity to every kind of learning implementation, including integrative or creative practice.
findings.fix: Require one-variable changes when the plan makes causal comparisons. For creative or integrative practice, default to one declared learning target while permitting coordinated changes when the user’s goal or time budget requires them.

findings.evidence: The newsletter case supplies no tutorial content, yet expects “Extract actionable lessons” and asserts “Names saved Markdown plan.” It does not verify the required provisional-plan labeling or distinguish an intended path from an actual write.
findings.fix: Make the missing-source case assert a transcript/content request or an explicitly provisional plan, no fabricated source lessons, and accurate write-status reporting. Add cases for noisy outcomes, inconsistent execution, and chat-only delivery.

findings.evidence: “Tutorial watched; help implement advice” is representative of a uniformly terse trigger set with little realistic context or buried intent.
findings.fix: Add varied casual and detailed prompts with source paths, deadlines, available time, and existing rep results. Include near-misses that request a lesson summary or project plan despite sharing implementation vocabulary.

findings.evidence: “Execution inconsistent: repeat the same rep until execution is reliable” has no retry limit or escalation. Persistent inconsistency can loop indefinitely despite the user's deadline and available-time constraints.
findings.fix: Time-box retries within the user's budget. After a failed repeat, route to shrinking the rep, removing a blocker, or renegotiating the target rather than repeating unchanged indefinitely.
